sources.author: Alan Vincelette
sources.title: The Characteristics, Distribution, Function, and Origin of Alternative Lateral Horse Gaits
sources.used_facts: Walk: lateral LH-LF-RH-RF sequence, near-quarter footfalls, continuous two/three-foot support; reported hind duty about .60-.70. No figures or motion data imported.

sources.title: A Review of Biomechanical Gait Classification with Reference to Collected Trot, Passage and Piaffe in Dressage Horses
sources.used_facts: Footfall timing, ground reaction forces, and COM mechanics are distinct classification criteria. Geometry alone does not certify balance. Used bibliographic abstract/search evidence; PMC full text access returned a browser challenge.

application: Rephase native candidate without borrowing motion data; keep original body/root/lengths. Candidate duty .535714 is below the typical real-walk reference and is NOT biological gait certification.
trunk_reference: Unweighted mean of native FrontShoulder.L/R and BackShoulder.L/R heads, projected to ground. No mass model or true COM.
